title: Piyush Bhagwat's Personal Information and Interests
content: Piyush Bhagwat, born on August 7, 2000, is originally from Bramhapuri, Chandrapur district, Maharashtra, India. He completed a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) degree and is currently enrolled in a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) program at Sinhagad Institute of Management in Pune, India. He is also enrolled in an applied AI and data intelligence program at Masai School. Piyush Bhagwat works as a backend software developer specializing in Node.js. His interests include backend web development using Node.js, HTML5 Canvas, REST APIs, and database management systems. He communicates in Hindi and English, preferring Hinglish written in Roman script for casual conversations. Piyush Bhagwat plays the flute as a personal hobby and practices calisthenics as a routine physical activity. He maintains an ambition to pursue wildlife photography. He explores 3D scene creation, interior lighting setup, and viewport rendering using Blender. He discusses philosophical concepts, human consciousness, identity, and classical literature such as Plato's Apology. Piyush Bhagwat engages in sketching, digital content creation, reading horror fiction, and fractal mathematics visualization. He maintains self-discipline routines, including keeping a mobile phone outside the sleeping area at night, avoiding screen usage before sleep, and using habit-tracking applications.
